name: table-of-contents
title: Table of Contents
description: Scrollspy links to the sections of a page, highlighting the section being read.
improvements: Scroll tracking uses an IntersectionObserver instead of a throttled scroll listener, and works inside scroll containers via root.
The active link is announced with aria-current="location".
Clicking a link scrolls smoothly (instantly with reduced motion), honours scroll-margin-top, updates the URL hash and moves focus to the section.
useScrollSpy is exported separately to build any custom scrollspy navigation.
